A region is a formation’s closure under a relation exactly where it holds the formation, is closed under the relation and lies within the closure (closure_iff_certified), which a finite computation can check in the finite case; a closed region holding one formation and not another separates their closures (not_within_of_closed). Periphery instance PreparationCorrespondence: being connected by the bonds is lying within the closure under the bonds read symmetrically (connected_iff_within); a component holding its root and closed on every remaining bond is that closure (component_is_closure), so certificate_exact_split follows from the core law (certificate_exact_split_by_core), and a certified cut leaves its two ends apart (cut_separates); the two grown graphs of matched composition have different mean cut returns (returns_differ), so by Readout.no_judge_of_merged no function of the parent summary gives both (no_parent_summary_predictor_by_core). Growth histories, sampling and the local production law keep their scope.
